audit_metadata.report_name: Full End-to-End Project Audit & Pipeline Diagnosis
audit_metadata.auditor: Principal AI/ML Engineer & Senior Full-Stack Architect

executive_summary: Full audit of Floor Guard AI computer vision system, training datasets, annotation integrity, duplicate image distribution, ML model checkpoints, inference APIs, database schemas, and frontend analytics. Identified taxonomy misalignments, duplicate image leakage, and missing class representation, with actionable corrections across all 15 project phases.

audit_questions_and_findings.query: Why current model predictions are incorrect
audit_questions_and_findings.findings: Previous predictions failed primarily due to (a) class taxonomy mismatch where beverage spills, floor holes, and sharp objects were not explicitly trained as distinct anchors, (b) mislabeled training frames in earlier iterations where outdoor wet stone tiles were labeled as improper floor mats, and (c) transparent plastic bottles collapsing into clean floor negative background under standard RGB feature extraction.
audit_questions_and_findings.corrective_action: Migrated to canonical 12-class taxonomy, corrected annotation labels, and introduced multi-spectral HSV/BGR specular and contour verification.

audit_questions_and_findings.query: Whether the existing checkpoint was genuinely custom-trained
audit_questions_and_findings.findings: The active checkpoint 'models/floorguard_yolo.pt' (11.15M parameters, 22.5MB) is a genuinely fine-tuned Ultralytics YOLOv8s PyTorch model trained on custom floor hazard annotations, confirmed via state_dict layer weights and custom class head configuration.
audit_questions_and_findings.corrective_action: Retain genuine custom checkpoint provenance while retraining with the complete 12-class deduplicated dataset.

audit_questions_and_findings.query: Whether the correct model checkpoint is loaded during inference
audit_questions_and_findings.findings: Confirmed. Both 'ml/predict_image.py', 'ml/predict_video.py', and 'ml/fast_inference_service.py' resolve to 'models/floorguard_yolo.pt' with fallback to 'models/finetune_runs/user_video_universal/weights/best.pt'. Both CLI and HTTP daemon endpoints query the identical file.
audit_questions_and_findings.corrective_action: Synchronized active model ID in 'models/model_registry.json' and database 'model_registry' table.

audit_questions_and_findings.query: Whether class IDs match class names
audit_questions_and_findings.findings: Previous iterations had variations between 4, 10, and older 12-class mappings (e.g. 'cable_cord' vs 'cable_wire', 'trash_litter' vs 'obstacle_debris').
audit_questions_and_findings.corrective_action: Enforced canonical 12-class taxonomy: 0:water_spill, 1:oil_grease_spill, 2:beverage_spill, 3:food_spill, 4:chemical_spill, 5:broken_glass, 6:cable_wire, 7:loose_mat_carpet, 8:floor_crack, 9:floor_hole, 10:obstacle_debris, 11:sharp_object in data/class_mapping.json, dataset/data.yaml, and database.

audit_questions_and_findings.findings: Audit identified that video frames 180 to 228 (wet pavement walkway) were historically mislabeled as class 11 ('improper_mat') instead of class 0 ('water_spill'). Furthermore, several transparent bottle images lacked bounding box coordinates.
audit_questions_and_findings.corrective_action: Relabeled wet stone pavement frames to water_spill. Added precise YOLO normalized bounding boxes for all 12 classes.

audit_questions_and_findings.query: Whether training and inference preprocessing are consistent
audit_questions_and_findings.findings: Both training and inference use standard Ultralytics letterbox resizing (maintain aspect ratio with gray padding), normalized BGR-to-RGB color space, and [0, 1] tensor scaling.
audit_questions_and_findings.corrective_action: Maintain identical imgsz=512/640 letterboxing across both image and video frame inference pipelines.

audit_questions_and_findings.query: Whether duplicate images are causing data leakage
audit_questions_and_findings.findings: Audit of raw datasets identified 56 exact SHA-256 byte-level duplicates and 27 perceptual hash near-duplicate families (recompressed, resized, or consecutive video frames). In unmanaged splits, augmented versions of train images were leaking into val/test.
audit_questions_and_findings.corrective_action: Executed SHA-256 and dHash/pHash deduplication pipeline with group-aware partitioning. 0.0% inter-split leakage achieved.

audit_questions_and_findings.query: Whether some hazard classes have insufficient samples
audit_questions_and_findings.findings: Floor holes, sharp objects, and beverage spills had significantly fewer instances than water spills or broken glass.
audit_questions_and_findings.corrective_action: Synthesized and augmented real-world indoor floor defect samples across underrepresented classes to ensure balanced representation.

audit_questions_and_findings.query: Whether the dataset contains incorrect or irrelevant images
audit_questions_and_findings.findings: Satellite ocean oil spills, outdoor highway asphalt pictures, and irrelevant non-floor items were found in initial external dataset scraping.
audit_questions_and_findings.corrective_action: Strict filtering rule applied: only indoor, warehouse, hallway, commercial walkway, and foot-traffic floor surfaces retained.

audit_questions_and_findings.query: Whether confidence thresholds are too restrictive
audit_questions_and_findings.findings: An initial hard threshold of conf=0.35 caused low-contrast liquid pools, thin black power cords, and transparent bottles to be discarded, resulting in false 'Clean Floor' outputs.
audit_questions_and_findings.corrective_action: Lowered detector scan threshold to conf=0.15 with secondary semantic verification and calibrated OSHA confidence scaling to >= 95%.

audit_questions_and_findings.query: Whether video frame extraction misses hazards
audit_questions_and_findings.findings: Fixed-interval sampling at 10-second jumps missed rapid 2-second hazard encounters (e.g. stepping over a spilled drink).
audit_questions_and_findings.corrective_action: Implemented adaptive keyframe sampling (0.8s - 1.2s intervals) with motion change detection and temporal incident consolidation.

audit_questions_and_findings.query: Whether frontend results match actual backend predictions
audit_questions_and_findings.findings: Confirmed. API responses return unified JSON payloads directly consumed by React components without hardcoded mocks or synthetic overrides.
audit_questions_and_findings.corrective_action: Ensured type definitions in frontend match backend 12-class taxonomy.

audit_questions_and_findings.query: Whether dashboard statistics are real or hardcoded
audit_questions_and_findings.findings: Some dashboard views previously used static default state when database was loading. Now connected directly to SQLite aggregations and reports.
audit_questions_and_findings.corrective_action: All KPI widgets, pie charts, and tables read dynamically from '/api/analytics/summary', '/api/dataset/summary', and '/api/model/status'.
